title: 第十一章 星魔神瓦沙克的坑哥方法
slug: 神印我魔族太女重铸魔族
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

枫溪顿了顿，缓缓道：“等到时候我拿这酒给你炖鸡，给你补身体。”

拿月光酿去炖鸡，这办法也就枫溪能想得出来。

要是月魔神阿加雷斯知道了，怕是气急败坏了。

因为枫溪这行为很明显就是糟蹋他的美酒。

对一个嗜酒如命的魔来说，这行为太可恶了！

“好吧……”

白玥还是同意了她这个胆大包天的想法。

白玥算是看明白了枫溪的性格。

正所谓，打不过就加入呗。

既然这月光酿有培本固元的功效，她没有灵力，这药效多半是被她的孩子所吸收，说不定还能提高她孩子的天赋。

她是一个母亲，对她的孩子有帮助，那必然是好东西。

再说了，枫溪是一个我行我素的性格。

她同不同意，在枫溪看来也不重要。

重要的是她吃就行了。

以枫溪的性子，自然是能做出来这种事情的。

“嘿嘿。”

枫溪再次对着白玥甜甜地一笑，“我亲爱的姐姐，难得来一次月池，我当然要弄点纪念品呗。”

“咳咳。”

一道柔弱的咳嗽声打断了枫溪和白玥两姐妹之间的对话，瞬间吸引到了她们的目光。

当枫溪和白玥的目光朝着声音来源处看去，两人的神情极为复杂。

一个蓝发蓝眸，俊美无俦，却又看起来极为柔弱，像是一阵风就能吹走的高大男人出现在她们的视线之中。

他的蓝色长发披散在腰间，额头上有着六芒星的眉印，他的蓝眸闪烁着淡淡的蓝光，眼角处有着金色的五角星印记。

紫色的月光折射下来，他蓝色的长发像是镀了一层紫光，更显得他柔弱了。

本来星魔神瓦沙克穿着一袭白袍搭配着蓝色的纹路，把自己包裹的严严实实的，就已经很有那份让人想欺负的柔弱感了。

现在还加上周围环境的点缀，他无疑更秀色可餐。

可惜，他已经是人夫，膝下已有独子。

“瓦沙克叔叔，一天天的你就知道吓唬人。”枫溪哼了一声，强烈地表达着自己的不满。

真吓到她了！

她还以为自己干坏事被月魔神阿加雷斯给抓了一个现场，却没想到发现她们的人是星魔神瓦沙克。

对枫溪来说，只要不是月魔神阿加雷斯本尊到来就好了。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Fengxi paused and said slowly: "When the time comes, I will use this wine to stew chicken for you to replenish your health."

Only Fengxi could think of a way to stew chicken with moonshine stuffing.

If Moon Demon God Agares knew about it, he would be furious.

Because Fengxi's behavior was obviously a waste of his wine.

What an abominable behavior for an alcoholic demon!

"Okay..."

Bai Yue still agreed to her bold idea.

Bai Yue finally understood Fengxi's character.

As the saying goes, if you can't beat it, just join.

Since this moonlight brew has the effect of strengthening the body and strengthening the body, and she has no spiritual power, the effect of this medicine is probably absorbed by her children, and it may even improve her children's talents.

She is a mother, and if it helps her children, it must be a good thing.

Besides, Fengxi is a character who goes his own way.

Whether she agrees or not is not important to Fengxi.

The important thing is that she just eats it.

With Fengxi's temperament, it is natural that he can do such a thing.

"Hehe."

Fengxi smiled sweetly at Bai Yue again, "My dear sister, it's rare to come to the Moon Pond, so of course I want to get some souvenirs."

"Ahem."

A weak cough interrupted the conversation between the two sisters Fengxi and Bai Yue, instantly attracting their attention.

When Feng Xi and Bai Yue looked towards the source of the sound, their expressions were extremely complicated.

A tall man with blue hair and blue eyes, handsome but extremely weak, as if he could be blown away by a gust of wind, appeared in their sight.

His long blue hair is spread around his waist, and there is a six-pointed star mark on his forehead. His blue eyes are shining with a faint blue light, and there is a golden five-pointed star mark at the corner of his eye.

The purple moonlight refracted, and his long blue hair seemed to be coated with a layer of purple light, making him look even more fragile.

Originally, Star Demon God Vasak was wearing a white robe with blue lines, wrapping himself tightly, and he already had a sense of weakness that made people want to bully him.

Now coupled with the embellishments of the surrounding environment, he is undoubtedly more beautiful and delicious.

Unfortunately, he is already a husband and has an only son.

"Uncle Vasak, you are getting better at scaring people every day." Fengxi snorted, strongly expressing his dissatisfaction.

It really scared her!

She thought she was caught doing bad things by the Moon Demon God Agares, but she didn't expect that the person who discovered them was the Star Demon God Vasak.

For Fengxi, it would be fine as long as the Moon Demon God Agares himself does not arrive.
